name: LABORATORY OIL BATH
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Laboratory Oil Bath is engineered for high-temperature chemical reactions, distillations, and materials testing that require heating well above the boiling point of water. Utilizing high-grade stainless steel, specialized thermal insulation, and an advanced PID controller, it safely handles hot silicone oils up to 200°C (or 300°C optionally) without the risk of breakdown, ensuring consistent thermal stability for complex experiments.
features: Designed for constant high-temperature control using thermal oil
Rugged double wall construction with excellent 5-sided glass wool insulation
Microprocessor PID temperature controller with ±1°C accuracy
Available in round and rectangular chamber configurations
Optional inner circulation or stirring function for uniform heating

specifications.Exterior Material: Stainless Steel 304 or Powder Coated MS
specifications.Standard Fittings: Brass drain tap, Mains On/off switch
